candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN

parameters.name: reasoning

exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports completed actions or states a conclusion without expressing a future intention.

candidate_predicates.name: IDENTIFIES_CAUSE_OF_FAILURE

parameters.name: reasoning
